excerpt: This means that we will both upgrade to the ASL-3 Required Safeguards and conduct a follow-up capability assessment to confirm that the ASL-4 Standard is not necessary.
paraphrase: Treating the model as having surpassed the threshold means upgrading to ASL-3 safeguards and conducting a follow-up assessment to rule out the need for ASL-4.

excerpt: To determine whether the measures we have adopted satisfy the ASL-3 Required Safeguards, we will conduct a safeguards assessment.
paraphrase: A safeguards assessment will be conducted to check whether adopted measures satisfy ASL-3 requirements.

excerpt: For the ASL-3 Deployment Standard, we will evaluate whether it is robust to persistent attempts to misuse the capability in question.
paraphrase: The ASL-3 Deployment Standard will be evaluated for robustness against persistent misuse attempts.

excerpt: For the ASL-3 Security Standard, we will evaluate whether it is highly protected against non-state attackers attempting to steal model weights.
paraphrase: The ASL-3 Security Standard will be evaluated for high protection against non-state actors attempting to steal model weights.

excerpt: If we determine that we have met the ASL-3 Required Safeguards, then we will proceed to deployment, provided we have also conducted a follow-up capability assessment.
paraphrase: If ASL-3 safeguards are met and a follow-up capability assessment has been conducted, Anthropic will proceed with deployment.

excerpt: In parallel with upgrading a model to the ASL-3 Required Safeguards, we will conduct a follow-up capability assessment to confirm that further safeguards are not necessary.
paraphrase: While upgrading to ASL-3 safeguards, a follow-up capability assessment will confirm whether further safeguards are needed.

excerpt: We are currently working on defining any further Capability Thresholds that would mandate ASL-4 Required Safeguards.
paraphrase: Anthropic is still working on defining further Capability Thresholds that would require ASL-4 safeguards.

locator: Executive Summary / Deployment and scaling outcomes
excerpt: We may deploy or store a model if either of the following criteria are met: (1) the model’s capabilities are sufficiently far away from the existing Capability Thresholds, making the current ASL-2 Standard appropriate; or (2) the model’s capabilities have surpassed the existing Capabilities Threshold, but we have implemented the ASL-3 Required Safeguards and conducted the follow-up capability assessment.
paraphrase: A model may be deployed or stored if it is sufficiently below Capability Thresholds under ASL-2, or if it has surpassed the threshold but ASL-3 safeguards and follow-up assessment have been completed.

locator: Executive Summary / Deployment and scaling outcomes
excerpt: In any scenario where we determine that a model requires ASL-3 Required Safeguards but we are unable to implement them immediately, we will act promptly to reduce interim risk to acceptable levels until the ASL-3 Required Safeguards are in place.
paraphrase: If ASL-3 safeguards are required but cannot be implemented immediately, Anthropic will act promptly to reduce interim risk until they are in place.

excerpt: To facilitate the effective implementation of this policy across the company, we commit to several internal governance measures, including maintaining the position of Responsible Scaling Officer, establishing a process through which Anthropic staff may anonymously notify the Responsible Scaling Officer of any potential instances of noncompliance, and developing internal safety procedures for incident scenarios.
paraphrase: Anthropic commits to internal governance measures including a Responsible Scaling Officer role, an anonymous noncompliance reporting process, and internal incident procedures.

excerpt: To advance the public dialogue on the regulation of frontier AI model risks and to enable examination of our actions, we will also publicly release key materials related to the evaluation and deployment of our models with sensitive information removed and solicit input from external experts in relevant domains.
paraphrase: Anthropic will publicly release evaluation and deployment materials (redacted of sensitive information) and seek external expert input to support public dialogue and scrutiny.

excerpt: As frontier AI models advance, we believe they will bring about transformative benefits for our society and economy.
paraphrase: Anthropic believes advancing frontier AI models will bring transformative societal and economic benefits.

excerpt: AI could accelerate scientific discoveries, revolutionize healthcare, enhance our education system, and create entirely new domains for human creativity and innovation.
paraphrase: AI is expected to accelerate science, transform healthcare, improve education, and enable new creative domains.

excerpt: Frontier AI models also, however, present new challenges and risks that warrant careful study and effective safeguards.
paraphrase: Frontier AI models also pose new risks requiring careful study and effective safeguards.

excerpt: In September 2023, we released our Responsible Scaling Policy (RSP), a first-of-its-kind public commitment not to train or deploy models capable of causing catastrophic harm unless we have implemented safety and security measures that will keep risks below acceptable levels.
paraphrase: Anthropic describes the September 2023 RSP release as a first-of-its-kind commitment not to train or deploy catastrophically dangerous models without adequate safeguards.
